crossRefs.note: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.
It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking…

translations.web: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
translations.bsb: Loving devotion and faithfulness preserve a king; by these he maintains his throne.
translations.kjv: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
translations.asv: Kindness and truth preserve the king; And his throne is upholden by kindness.
